requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL parse RuntimeInstance declarations from the runtime domain into loader output without executing code.

case.given: a bundle contains a RuntimeInstance declaration
case.then: the loader SHALL expose serializable runtime instance data without executing its code

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL parse Scope runtime/config/command bindings into loader output without interpreting runtime object internals.

case.given: a Scope contains runtime, config, or command bindings
case.then: the output SHALL remain serializable binding data

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL validate RuntimeInstance source exclusivity at loader time.

case.then: exactly one source family SHALL be accepted

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL include dotted halfcode schemes in loader reference collection.

case.given: a bundle contains a supported runtime-domain reference
case.then: the reference SHALL be included in the loader output
